scope: Independent production review only; no production/probe edits, phone, IDE, services, builds, commits or uploads. Only this review MD/JSON written.

sourceEligibility.sao: Original index and tile admission membership + publication/geometry binding + frozen geometry/observer/matrix

sourceEligibility.geometryFreeze: Newly generated geometry only; independently observed original anchor geometry children remain unfrozen and unchanged

release.layerMiss: corresponding old layer dropped before build or withdrawal
release.exception: both lists and key reset on builder/replay error
release.rendererReplacement: key prevents reuse; normal lifecycle additionally resets before disposal
release.nativeCaveat: Clearing JS preparation references does not establish successful native/GPU destruction

independent source arrival/withdrawal and same-time source replacement use current admitted facts
mutable/legacy inputs, failed construction and explicit reset never revive cached A

counterchecks.name: observer invalidation cannot revive an obsolete resolved frame
assertions: Resolve admitted frame A on an isolated scene with copied observer
Change scene.observer.longitude by +1 with geometry unchanged: resolver returns undefined
Restore longitude: resolver returns a valid different frame, not original A

counterchecks.name: frozen unadmitted SAO clone cannot retain prepared drawings
assertions: Deep-freeze structuredClone of actual index and one actual tile
Aggregate resolves but isReusableSkyStellarSupplementFrame is false
Render twice through full old and candidate Scene: complete outputs equal
BSC builds once; unadmitted SAO builds twice

counterchecks.name: mutable source withdrawal retires only its independent layer
assertions: Two repeated admitted SAO paints build once
Switch to aggregate from mutable actual-source clones, then return original admitted aggregate
Both outputs match old full Scene
BSC build count remains 1; SAO build count becomes 3

counterchecks.name: new exact geometry does not freeze or mutate original report geometry
assertions: Use skyTimeTestFixture actual report and present model startAt + 1000 ms
New geometry, observer and matrix differ by identity from original anchor
Original geometry values unchanged; original geometry/observer/matrix remain unfrozen

additionalExistingCheck.name: fractional ruler input moves actual solar and observation geometry between supplied instants

independentlyExecuted.execution: Retained frozen full-Scene test source transpiled/evaluated in memory with its original module base. Selected four tests; appended three mechanism counterchecks in memory. No temporary script written. Separate in-memory actual time fixture checked freeze ownership.
independentlyExecuted.baselineLimit: Frozen r20 full draw uses current production resolver/transform dependencies and no-op probe wrappers; it proves complete Scene-output equivalence in these cases, not every old resolver behavior, native pixels, CPU or retained heap.
independentlyExecuted.workload: Actual full BSC 8404 rows, >100 real selected SAO tiles and >2000 SAO rows through original admission; nonempty star submission/pick/name assertions retained

costAssessment.newNoHitWork: One Point wrapper per prepared visible star, point array allocation and replay, plus exact key/eligibility checks. Every new exact Play instant may miss.
costAssessment.currentWorkingSet: Current lists retain original star/projection records in addition to existing transition snapshots and transform state. No whole-page total memory bound is established.
costAssessment.performanceVerdict: No new timing claim. Existing local block comparison is not current-phone performance. Matched ordinary Play no-hit/full draw and continuation observations remain required.
costAssessment.instrumentationBoundary: r21 starTraversal must include build/cache lookup and actual replay; SAO span includes exits. This review does not certify the other agent task adapter.
